items.title_en: AI Startup Wonderful Raises Funds at $5 Billion Valuation
items.summary_zh: AI Startup Wonderful Raises Funds at $5 Billion Valuation bloomberg.com
items.summary_en: AI startup Wonderful raised fresh funding at a $5 billion valuation. Specific business details and investors are not yet disclosed, but the deal underscores high investor enthusiasm for AI ventures.
items.why_zh: 50亿美元估值再次印证AI初创企业的资本热度，同时也给Wonderful带来证明其技术前景与商业回报的压力。
items.why_en: The $5 billion valuation highlights the strong investor appetite for AI startups and the pressure to justify their lofty worth.

items.title_zh: 豆包、GLM、Kimi都在这条带上！百年京张AI创新带要搞“词元经济”
items.title_en: Doubao, GLM and Kimi Join Beijing-Zhangjiakou AI Innovation Belt for a 'Token Economy'
items.summary_zh: 豆包、GLM、Kimi都在这条带上！百年京张AI创新带要搞“词元经济” 新浪财经
items.summary_en: According to Sina Finance, the century-old Beijing-Zhangjiakou railway area is being positioned as an AI innovation belt featuring Doubao, GLM and Kimi, with plans to build a token economy. The report gives few specifics on scale or timeline. The initiative shows how large-model competition is extending into regional industrial strategies.
items.why_zh: 将主流大模型纳入区域产业规划，说明AI竞争已进入基础设施与区域生态布局阶段。
items.why_en: Bringing major AI models into regional planning signals that AI competition now includes infrastructure and ecosystem development.

items.title_zh: 小米 18 Fold“中折叠”手机拥有 1.2 米抗跌落能力，雷军称媲美直板旗舰
items.title_en: Xiaomi 18 Fold 'Mid-Fold' Phone Teased: 1.2m Drop Resistance and Flagship-Level Durability
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，小米创办人、董事长兼 CEO 雷军今晚发文，预热小米 18 Fold“中折叠”手机。 IT之家注：小米 18 Fold 手机将于 9 月 7 日（下周一）晚 7 点在小米秋季旗舰新品发布会上正式发布，首发玄戒 O3 旗舰处理器。 据雷军介绍，小米 18 Fold 拥有 1.2 米抗跌落能力，可靠性媲美直板旗舰；相比小米 MIX Fold 4 手机，尖锐物体抗冲击性提升 258%，钢球重物跌落高度提升 214%。 小米 18 Fold 采用新一代小米龙骨转轴，自然水滴形态，三级连杆结构，全贴合保护。 小米 18 Fold 搭载全新双层 UTG 超薄玻璃，屏幕强度、抗冲击性大幅提升。 此外，小米 18 Fold 前后双面搭载小米龙晶玻璃 3.0，中框采用航天级 7 系铝合金。 小米官方今日公布了小米 18 Fold“中折叠”手机官图，新机采用极窄四等边 + 超椭圆大 R 角设计，后置跑道型 Deco + 侧边纯平包裹式中框。 相关阅读： 《 小米 18 Fold“中折叠”手机将搭载小爱灵感球：轻松一拖即可完成各类任务 》 《 小米 18 Fold“中折叠”手机官图发布：极窄四等边、跑道型 Deco，新色命名「西野红」 》 《 雷军：小米 18 Fold“中折叠”旗舰手机搭载 Xiaomi MiMo 端侧大模型 》 《 小米 18 Fold 手机外观亮相：新…
items.summary_en: Xiaomi CEO Lei Jun previewed the upcoming Xiaomi 18 Fold 'mid-fold' phone, set to launch on September 7 with the Xuanjie O3 processor. The phone is claimed to offer 1.2m drop resistance, 258% better sharp-object impact resistance and a 214% higher steel-ball drop height than the MIX Fold 4. It also features a new hinge, dual-layer UTG glass, Longjing Glass 3.0 and an aerospace-grade 7-series aluminum frame.
items.why_zh: 折叠屏耐用性一直被用户质疑，小米以媲美直板旗舰的抗跌落能力为卖点，有望改变折叠屏“娇贵”的认知。
items.why_en: By promoting drop resistance comparable to traditional flagships, Xiaomi may help ease durability concerns that often deter users from foldables.

items.title_zh: B.AI 宣布 API Key 支持通过 Codex 调用 DeepSeek 模型
items.title_en: B.AI API Keys Now Support DeepSeek Models via Codex
items.summary_zh: B.AI 宣布 API Key 支持通过 Codex 调用 DeepSeek 模型 CryptoRank
items.summary_en: B.AI has announced that its API key can now be used to call DeepSeek models via Codex, according to CryptoRank. The update lowers the barrier for developers to use DeepSeek inside Codex-based workflows. Specific usage quotas, pricing and availability details have not yet been published.
items.why_zh: DeepSeek再获一个落地入口，开发者调用大模型的工具链更加多元化。
items.why_en: Adding Codex support gives DeepSeek another distribution channel and makes AI model access easier for developers.

items.title_zh: Anthropic发布Fable 5.1，正式加入AI价格战
items.title_en: Anthropic Joins AI Price War With Release of Fable 5.1
items.summary_zh: 据AI Business报道，Anthropic发布Fable 5.1，并正式加入AI价格战。这一举动意味着头部AI公司之间的竞争已经从模型性能延伸到调用成本与商业模式。大模型厂商接连调整定价策略，将直接影响企业采用AI服务的门槛和成本结构。目前关于Fable 5.1的具体性能、价格策略和适用场景仍未公开。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Joins AI Price War With Release of Fable 5.1 AI Business
items.why_zh: 以能力见长的Anthropic也加入价格战，说明大模型商业化已进入成本竞争阶段。
items.why_en: Anthropic's entry into the price war shows that cost, not just capability, is now crucial in the AI market.

items.title_zh: OpenAI发布Astra：影响不止于AI能力提升
items.title_en: OpenAI’s Astra Release Changes More Than AI Capabilities
items.summary_zh: OpenAI的Astra正式发布，相关分析认为这次发布带来的变化将超出AI能力本身的提升。Astra可能影响AI产品的使用方式、开发者的应用生态，乃至行业竞争逻辑。报道更关注其战略意义，而非单纯的技术参数。可以预见，这类平台级发布将推动AI竞争从模型能力层面进入体验与生态构建层面。
items.summary_en: OpenAI’s Astra Release Changes More Than AI Capabilities uctoday.com
items.why_zh: Astra发布被视为AI竞争从技术能力走向生态与商业模式竞争的风向标。
items.why_en: Astra’s launch signals that AI competition is shifting from raw capabilities to ecosystem and business impact.

items.title_zh: 以简驭繁：规模化企业的AI集成之道
items.title_en: Facilitating AI integration with simplicity at scale
items.summary_zh: 企业在规模化过程中，技术系统如果缺乏整合，反而会成为负担。分散的系统、站点级工具、电子表格和人工流程容易形成数据孤岛，妨碍问题预警、协作响应和决策信心。全球制造企业Jabil拥有超过100个工厂、业务覆盖30多个国家，其应对思路是把“简化优先、再谈创新”作为原则，优先整合系统和流程。Jabil的SAP IT总监Harish Manohar表示，这种做法帮助公司在复杂的全球运营中为AI落地铺平道路。这个案例说明，简化不是绕开AI，而是让AI更好地发挥价值的前提。
items.summary_en: As companies scale, the technology supporting operations can become a liability just as quickly as it becomes an asset. Disconnected systems, site-specific tools, spreadsheets, and manual workarounds can create data silos that make it harder to spot problems early, coordinate responses, and make decisions with confidence. For Jabil, a global manufacturing company with more than 100 sites across more than 30 countries, the answer has been to make integration and simplification a priority. The company adopted a “simplify-first, then-innovate mindset,” says Harish Manohar, SAP IT director at Jabi…
items.why_zh: 许多AI项目失败源于底层系统混乱，“先简化、再创新”可作为企业规模化落地AI的方法参考。
items.why_en: This case offers a practical approach for companies dealing with siloed systems: simplify and integrate before adding AI.

items.title_zh: 新研究：变异AI群体在变化环境中胜过优化模型
items.title_en: New research proves mutant AI swarms outperform optimized models in a changing world
items.summary_zh: 一项新研究指出，在动态变化的环境中，由突变机制生成的AI智能体群体（swarm）比经过传统优化训练的模型表现更优。该成果挑战了“静态优化”思路，暗示在不确定条件下，演化式或群体式方法可能更具适应性。目前公开资料有限，具体实验设计、模型类型与评测基准尚未披露。这项研究或对未来构建能应对环境漂移的AI系统具有借鉴意义。
items.summary_en: New research proves mutant AI swarms outperform optimized models in a changing world PR Newswire
items.why_zh: 这为AI在变化环境中的持续适应提供了新思路，可能推动群体智能与演化算法在AI系统中的融合。
items.why_en: It suggests an alternative to static optimization for AI in dynamic worlds, potentially boosting interest in swarm and evolutionary approaches.

items.title_zh: 找钢网集团联合腾讯WorkBuddy发布国内首款B2B贸易行业AI Agent NextB2B
items.title_en: Zhaogang and Tencent WorkBuddy launch NextB2B, China's first B2B trade AI Agent
items.summary_zh: 找钢网集团联合腾讯WorkBuddy发布国内首款B2B贸易行业AI Agent NextB2B Sohu
items.summary_en: Zhaogang.com Group and Tencent WorkBuddy have jointly launched NextB2B, described as China's first AI Agent for the B2B trade industry. It marks an early move to apply agentic AI to trade workflows. Detailed capabilities have not been announced.
items.why_zh: 作为国内首款B2B贸易行业AI Agent，它标志着AI Agent开始进入大宗商品贸易等垂直核心业务场景。
items.why_en: As China's first B2B trade AI Agent, it represents a milestone for agentic AI entering vertical industry operations.
